findings.claim: Acceptance 'Every card has a Try example' is graded only against the stub _UI_MATRIX; nothing ties EXAMPLES keys to the real-site rows of docs/support-matrix.md, so a new or renamed real-site row renders a card with no Try button while the gate stays green.
findings.evidence: src/browser/eval_adapter.py _run_ui_form_case: want_cards derived from _UI_MATRIX (3 real rows, all present in EXAMPLES by construction); src/browser/server.py EXAMPLES keyed by the exact domain string ('wikipedia.org' vs 'books.toscrape.com (live)'); only other reference to EXAMPLES is the 'const EXAMPLES' fragment in ui-execution-progress.json.
findings.repro: Scratch copy: append '| example.org (live) | — | — | — | — | — |' to the Current matrix table, render PAGE with parse_matrix() via route interception → card 'example.org' with buttons: 0; run_case on ui-no-url-guard.json and ui-execution-progress.json both return passed=True.
findings.acceptance: A fast/invariant check goes red when any non-fixture row of parse_matrix() lacks an EXAMPLES entry (e.g. the form case also drives the real payload, or a pure-code check parses EXAMPLES keys out of PAGE and compares to parse_matrix() rows).

findings.claim: siteInTask() lifts file/extension tokens and e-mail domains into a start URL and submits immediately, spending a run that ends failure:nav (pre-plan navigate fails before planning, so $0 but a slot and a red result).
findings.evidence: src/browser/server.py siteInTask regex \b(?:[a-z0-9-]+\.)+[a-z]{2,}; measured: 'What version of node.js is listed?' → https://node.js, 'Open README.md and read the title' → https://README.md, 'Find setup.exe download link' → https://setup.exe, 'Open index.html' → https://index.html, 'email john@example.com about it' → https://example.com; URL is written to #url and POSTed in the same click (submitTask line ~705-735).
findings.repro: page.evaluate("siteInTask('What version of node.js is listed?')") on the rendered PAGE → 'https://node.js'; with a live server this POSTs {url:'https://node.js'}.
findings.acceptance: Common file extensions / e-mail local parts are not lifted (or the lifted URL requires a second confirming click); the form case gains one such input asserting no POST and the guidance shown.

findings.claim: quotes.toscrape.com card says 'Static pages work' — a domain-level capability claim the doc does not declare (row is TC1 unsupported; the only evidence is one run, 24820d4c, now 404 on the deployment).
findings.evidence: src/browser/server.py EXAMPLES['quotes.toscrape.com (live)'].note; docs/support-matrix.md rows: 'quotes.toscrape.com (live) | unsupported'; curl https://whaleforce-browser-agent.zeabur.app/tasks/24820d4c → {"detail":"unknown run_id"}.
findings.repro: Render the page; card reads '× Read a page — doesn't work' followed by 'Static pages work; …'.
findings.acceptance: Note phrased as the receipt, not a generalisation, e.g. 'This static page answered correctly once (run 24820d4c); the declared failure is the JS-rendered /js/ pages.'

findings.claim: PR #32 body carries no example run_id receipts although Acceptance requires them 'cited in the code and the PR evidence', and 6 of the 9 cited ids (ac69e850, bcdc8f8a, 24820d4c, 6a828ddb, 015b6778, 8b588f84) already 404 on the deployment, so the PR evidence is the only durable record.

findings.claim: Case provenance cites dangling commits: ui-no-url-guard.json says 'watched red against the pre-M35 page (main 2a11142)' and ui-execution-progress.json cites e07ac07 — neither is on any branch (pre-rebase objects), so the red-first evidence becomes unreachable after gc and '2a11142' is not main.
findings.evidence: git branch -a --contains 2a11142 / e07ac07 → empty; origin/main is 2e94bed, branch commits are b7daac4/1f64445.
findings.acceptance: Provenance cites reachable shas (b7daac4 as the pre-M35 page; the watched-red amendment against the branch's own prior commit or a described patch).

findings.claim: The shared _ui_page (390,dark) render carries the form case's state into ui-rendered-narrow: window.fetch stays stubbed, #err is visible with 'Error: stubbed: no run', #task/#url hold the last chip's values — order-coupled via sorted filenames; passes today, no failure reproduced.
findings.evidence: src/browser/eval_adapter.py _run_ui_form_case sets window.fetch and never restores it; evals/run.py sorted(rglob) runs ui-no-url-guard.json before ui-rendered-narrow.json; _UI_PAGES pages stay open until atexit _shutdown closes the browser.
findings.repro: Observation only — run fast suite, both pass; state is visible by evaluating document.getElementById('err').hidden on the cached page after the form case.
findings.acceptance: Form case restores window.fetch and resets #err/#task/#url at the end (or the rendered case asserts its own preconditions) so the two cases are order-independent.
